entities.name: Expanded Plantations and Emancipation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After the Garifuna deportation, British planters expanded sugar estates across the entire island. Emancipation came in 1834 with an apprenticeship period ending in 1838. Portuguese, East Indian, and other indentured laborers were subsequently imported to supplement the labor force.
